item.title: Meduza: Andrey Chibis spent seven years consolidating power in Russia’s Arctic Murmansk region. Now the Kremlin loyalist is in police custody on charges of funneling public money abroad.
item.description: On November 23, police detained Murmansk Governor Andrey Chibis as he stepped off the plane at Moscow’s Sheremetyevo Airport. He had flown to Moscow on official business. Authorities opened a criminal case against him on suspicion of fraud and embezzlement, making him the first sitting governor to face criminal proceedings since the war began.
